statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the maximum, over all sets S subset of {0,...,n-1} such that for every i,j in S with i < j we have j > i + b_i, of the sum of p_i over i in S. The empty set is allowed and has sum 0. Equivalently, r is the maximum total points obtainable by choosing solved questions in order, where solving i forbids solving any j with i < j <= i + b_i.
